load_checkpoint: load a JAX Pytree checkpoint from a .npz file path or dict-like object
traverse_with_names: traverse a JAX Pytree and yield flat (name, value) pairs for each leaf node
tree_flatten_with_names: flatten a JAX Pytree into a list of (name, value) pairs preserving leaf names
recover_tree: reconstruct a nested dict tree from flat slash-separated key paths and corresponding values
canonicalize_text: canonicalize text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, collapsing whitespace, and appending a period
